Class ShapeLogger

Namespace
ShapeEngine.StaticLib
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides static methods for logging messages to the console and/or a file with configurable log levels and output types.

Remarks

LogFilePath has to be set and valid for File or Both to work. Use SetLogFilePath(string) to set a new file path or change the existing one. Use ClearLogFile() to clear the contents of the current log file.

ClearLogFile()

Clears the contents of the current log file if the log file path is valid. Returns true if the file was cleared; otherwise, false.

public static bool ClearLogFile()

bool

Log(object, string, LogLevel)

Logs a message with the specified log level from the given caller object. If logging is disabled or the log level is below the minimum, the message is not logged.

StartLogBlock(string, LogLevel)

Starts a new log block with the specified title and log level. If a log block is already active, it ends the current block before starting a new one.

public static void StartLogBlock(string title, LogLevel level = LogLevel.Info)

Parameters

title string

The title of the log block.

level LogLevel

The log level for the block. Defaults to LogLevel.Info.
